implementation.primary: Scale zero plus eight signed halfwords using unsigned strength, expand 31 knots, validate channels zero through six with short-circuit failure.
implementation.secondary: The same scale and expansion, validating only channel six.
implementation.geometry: Peak selection, twenty integer square-root iterations, base coefficient, cubic reciprocal gain, axis coefficient, reciprocal and iterative grid cost classification execute as owned numeric CPU.
implementation.retained_result: 31 u32 knots followed by eight halfwords corresponding to offsets 0x7c through 0x8a; caller-owned state persists across attempts until clear().
implementation.configuration: Encoded configuration byte 0x18f45 controls radial interpolation in addition to the coefficient-exceeds-unity condition.
donor_corrections: Actual 0x6e3598,0x6e35a0,0x6e35b4 and 0x6e36e8,0x6e36f0,0x6e3704 use 32-bit MUL before right shift; only the fourth cubic product uses UMULL. The NONMATCHING donor uses 64-bit products for all four.
Actual 0x745238 uses a byte at channel descriptor stride 20, then halfword and byte fields at geometry descriptor stride 10. Donor pointer casts do not describe this layout.
0x6e345c reads X-M1 configuration key 0x18f45, not the sibling source key 0x1b82b.
0x6e3b04 returns with no meaningful integer result. Callers inspect the output resolution halfword.
implementation.failure_contract: Missing configuration returns Capacity; zero divisors or an interpolation span outside the owned 31 knots return Range. Firmware validity rejection returns Ok(false). No backend or environment callback implements numeric work.

tests.provenance: Synthetic neutral curves, one-unit fixed-point transitions, signed sample bits at zero strength, missing configuration, retained grid metadata and explicit clear behavior.

limits: Source inspection and authenticated byte disassembly only; no build, tests, lint, native execution, SDK execution or camera I/O performed.
Projection integration and module registration are owned by the startup projection integration partition.
